name: Lineups tab is reachable and activatable by keyboard
description: When a keyboard-only visitor tabs through a match detail page, the Lineups control receives a visible focus indicator and activating it with Enter reveals the lineups panel content.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Press Tab repeatedly until the Lineups control receives keyboard focus
Verify the Lineups control shows a visible focus indicator when focused via the keyboard
Press Enter to activate the focused Lineups control
Verify the lineups panel becomes visible and exposes at least one named starting player row after keyboard activation
